mailer_templates_confirmation_content:
Welcome aboard, sailor ⚓

Confirm your email to activate your Vessel Supplier account — your kit rides with your ship's ETA.

Confirm my email

If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
{{ .SiteURL }}auth/confirm?token_hash={{ .TokenHash }}&type=email

Didn't create this account? Just ignore this email.
mailer_templates_recovery_content:
Reset your password

Happens at sea. Tap below to set a new password for Vessel Supplier:

Reset my password

If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
{{ .SiteURL }}auth/confirm?token_hash={{ .TokenHash }}&type=recovery&next=/reset-password

If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email — your password stays the same.
